name: Matomo

evidence.web: F02: primary category is website analytics; F15: pages, sources, campaigns, locations, devices and goals
evidence.product: F16: events are core; funnels and acquisition-date retention cohorts on paid plans or the paid self-host extension
evidence.replay: F17: session replay and click, move and scroll heatmaps on Cloud and the paid self-host plugin
evidence.revenue: F19: built-in ecommerce reports for orders, products, sales conversion and average order value

line: Open-source analytics you can host yourself or buy as Cloud.

free.text: Free self-host: unlimited users/hits; Cloud 21-day trial

cells.location: Germany primary, Ireland backups; NZ support access

pv.math: 10,000 pageviews count as 10,000 hits. The 50,000-hit band costs INR 1,690 a month.
100,000 pageviews count as 100,000 hits. The 100,000-hit band costs INR 3,090 a month.
1,000,000 pageviews count as 1,000,000 hits. The 1m-hit band costs INR 13,900 a month.
